units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 45:27">Ib. XLV, 27</cite> <he>רוח נבואה</he> (O. ed. Berl. <cite ref="S00252"><he>קודשא</he></cite>) = h. <he>רוח הקדש</he>, v. <cite ref="T00345">preced.</cite>; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:13">Gen. R. s. 38</cite>, end <he>נסגוד לר׳ וכ׳</he> let us worship the wind that scatters the clouds; <he>ונסגוד לבר … ר׳</he> let us worship man that carries the wind (whose body is filled with air).

<cite ref="Gittin 67b:11">Gitt. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>דהא ר׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="S00574"><he>קוּרְדְּיָיקוֹס</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>רוּחִין</he>, <he>רוּחַיָּא</he>, <he>רוּחֵי</he>, <he>רוּחָתָא</he>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 32:24">Targ. Y. I ib.</cite> <he>רווחין</he> (corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="T00329"><he>רְוַוח</he> I</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Shek. V, end, 49ᵇ <he>רבהון דרוּחַיָּיא</he> the chief of the evil spirits.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:11">Gen. R. s. 20</cite>, end <he>ר׳ דביתא טבין וכ׳</he> the spirits of a man’s house are benevolent, for they grow up with him; <he>ר׳ דחקלא</he> the spirits of the field; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:11">ib.</cite> s. 24, end.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> <he>שידא שריהון דר׳</he> Sheda (demon), the prince of the spirits.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 25a:10">B. Bath. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>לכל ר׳ אוקמן וכ׳</he> place me (for prayer) in any direction except due east; a. fr.
